settings.question: How do I choose the right fit?
settings.answer: Start with the VANTA FORM measurement guide. Model-specific fit guidance helps you configure before ordering.

settings.question: Can this model be customized?
settings.answer: Available configuration options appear above. Bespoke options will be offered separately for eligible models.

settings.question: How do I care for it?
settings.answer: Care depends on the selected material and finish. Every order includes configuration-specific care guidance.

settings.question: Is shipping discreet?
settings.answer: Yes. Orders are prepared with privacy in mind using plain outer packaging.
